deadline.value: Fall: January 15 for U.S. and international applicants (February 1 for Canadian residents); priority to complete applications by the deadline, some programs keep accepting while space remains. Year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: February 1 (Canadian resident) | January 15 (U.S. and international) | Priority will be given to complete applications submitted by the deadline.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: No admission offer until a supervisor match is made; name potential supervisors in the statement of purpose and contact them (the department may help match)
supervisor.quote: Prospective graduate students must be selected by one or two (in case of joint supervision) faculty members as a condition for final admission.

also.quote: An admission offer will not be issued until a supervisor match has been made.

funding.value: Supervisor(s) and department commit to arranging support for at least the first two years (no minimum amount stated); support usually combines RA, fellowship and TA, and most admitted international students get help bringing tuition to the Quebec-resident rate
funding.quote: Upon admission, the research supervisor(s) and the department accept the responsibility for ensuring and arranging the financial support for the student for at least two years, contingent upon satisfactory performance.

also.quote: Most admitted international students receive financial support to help maintain tuition costs at the Quebec resident rate.

entry_route.value: Admission requires an MSc in physics or a related field with high standing; applicants submit a copy of their master's thesis
entry_route.quote: MSc degree in Physics or a related field with high standing from a recognized university.

also.quote: A copy of your Master's thesis

notes: English-taught Montreal university; international tuition is high unless reduced to the Quebec rate through department support. Supervision commitment covers at least two years.
